## Objectives {#objectives}

1. Understand and name your own emotions.
   - Identify your emotions.
   - Know what emotions do for you.
2. Decrease the frequency of unwanted emotions.
   - Stop unwanted emotions from starting in the first place.
   - Change unwanted emotions once they start.
3. Decrease emotional vulnerability.
   - Decrease vulnerability to emotion mind.
   - Increase resiliency and your ability to cope with difficult things and positive emotions.
4. Decrease emotional suffering.
   - Reduce suffering when painful emotions overcome you.
   - Manage extreme emotions so that you do not make things worse.
